name: Tou Tsung-hua
bio: Tou Tsung-hua was born on 10 October 1962 in Taipei, Taiwan. He is an actor, known for Lust, Caution (2007), Copycat Killer (2023) and Requital (1992). He was previously married to Si Chen. He won the 2005 Golden Bell Award for Best Actor.
